principles: Always retain the original Sportstiming checkpoint_source_label and raw checkpoint_key.
Semantic checkpoint mapping is year-specific because course and timing layouts changed.
Named timing observations outrank distance-only aliases when both exist.
For 2022/2023, 32 km and Bengtemölla are not collapsed: Sportstiming reports only 0.1 km between them, but aggregate elapsed gaps are too large and variable to treat them as duplicate readings.

A distance-only checkpoint may map to a landmark with high confidence when organizer/route geometry independently places the named landmark at the same rounded distance; the confidence and evidence must remain explicit.
Operational interpretations such as prewarning, aid-station entry or aid-station exit remain hypotheses until physical mat placement or organizer documentation verifies them.

working_hypotheses.hypothesis: The 32 km observation is an approach/prewarning reading and the named Bengtemölla observation is recorded on departure after the runner has passed through the aid station.
basis: Sportstiming orders 32 km immediately before Bengtemölla and reports only 0.1 km/100 m between the observations.
Across 60-runner samples the elapsed gap is much longer and more variable than ordinary running time for 100 m: median 255 s in 2022 and 142.5 s in 2023.
A runner familiar with the event considers a speaker prewarning followed by a departure mat after food/drink service plausible.
working_hypotheses.analysis_rule: Use Bengtemölla as the canonical checkpoint. Preserve 32 km separately. The difference may be exposed as an aid-station/service-window candidate but must not be labelled confirmed stationary dwell time.

mappings.evidence: Immediately precedes named Bengtemölla in Sportstiming; source segment distance is 100 meter/0.1 km. Aggregate 60-runner samples show median gaps 255 s (2022) and 142.5 s (2023), so it is retained separately.

Use as the canonical named Bengtemölla checkpoint while retaining the preceding 32 km observation. Working hypothesis: this reading may be at aid-station departure after service, but mat placement is not independently verified.

Distance-only timing label. Bengtemölla is independently placed at about 33.5-33.6 km by route/waypoint evidence, so 34 km is treated as its rounded timing checkpoint while the source label remains visible.

derived_relations.interpretation: Elapsed time between the two observations. Under the working hypothesis it approximates approach plus aid-station service until departure, but it must remain labelled a service-window candidate until physical mat placement is verified.
